overall_comment: Predictions are based only on structured conventional MRI metadata without DWI/ADC, perfusion, spectroscopy, SWI/GRE, or histology. The presence of marked enhancement, necrotic component, thick enhancing margin, and extensive edema drives the high-grade and IDH-wildtype estimate. Cortical/frontoparietal involvement adds some uncertainty for IDH and 1p/19q, but does not outweigh the aggressive imaging phenotype.
